digest.component_or_area: test harness — nested pytest subprocess isolation
propositions: The nested pytest child process omits --basetemp argument, causing it to join the user-global numbered temp root instead of using a caller-owned private directory.

At pytest session finish, TempPathFactory synchronously scans and recursively deletes stale numbered temp trees via cleanup_numbered_dir, which can consume the entire 90-second child timeout even after the selected test reports 100%.
Controlled A/B testing with 400,000 stale shared-root entries demonstrates cleanup cost scales with retained entries (shared 10.8s vs private 0.882s), confirming the mechanism.
The nested child deletion of another run's temp sentinel files violates the helper's isolation invariant that ambient tracker HEAD/directories remain unchanged.

Passing --basetemp with a caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest directory to the nested child isolates pytest cleanup without changing node selection, environment, timeout, capture, or ambient-store assertions.
